files_summary./app/database/products.csv:
Cleaned e‑commerce product catalogue (≈ 1,000 rows). Columns include: timestamp, title, seller_name, brand, description, initial_price, final_price (numeric USD), currency, availability, reviews_count, categories (JSON list), asin (unique product ID), buybox_seller, number_of_sellers, root_bs_rank, answered_questions, domain, images_count, url, video_count, image_url, item_weight, rating, product_dimensions, seller_id, date_first_available, discount, model_number, manufacturer, department, plus_content, upc, video, top_review, variations (JSON), delivery, features, format, buybox_prices, parent_asin, input_asin, ingredients, origin_url, bought_past_month, is_available, root_bs_category, bs_category, bs_rank, badge, subcategory_rank, amazon_choice, images, product_details, prices_breakdown, country_of_origin, etc.

The file is derived from the public "amazon‑products.csv" sample dataset (BrightData/eCommerce‑dataset‑samples) and saved as a cleaned CSV ready for import.
files_summary./app/database/users.csv: Synthetic user table (500 records) for a local application. Columns: user_id (int, primary key), first_name, last_name, email (unique, example: john.doe1@example.com), signup_date (date within the last 2 years), city, country. Data generated with Faker to provide realistic personal information.
files_summary./app/database/orders.csv: Synthetic orders table (1,000 records) linking users to products. Columns: order_id (int, primary key), user_id (foreign key to users.csv), asin (foreign key to products.csv), order_date (date within the last year), quantity (1‑5), unit_price (numeric, taken from product final_price), total_price (quantity × unit_price, rounded to 2 decimals). This file creates a logically consistent transaction dataset for testing joins, analytics, and reporting.

tool_schemas.name: get_product_by_asin
tool_schemas.description: Returns detailed product information for the Amazon product identified by the provided ASIN. It refuses requests where the ASIN is missing, empty, or not a valid ASIN string, because the product identifier cannot be resolved. It also refuses requests for ASINs that do not correspond to any product available to the service, because there is no product record to return.

asin.description: Amazon Standard Identification Number of the product.

metadata.name: Pinnacle ASIN Insight Service
metadata.description: Retrieves comprehensive product details for a given Amazon ASIN via a simple API endpoint.
